To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the logistic sigmoid activation function, with proper rescale and a small modification, can be used to train deep convolution networks as effectively as the hyperbolic tangents.

(1) we point out that, beside the well-known non zero centered property, slope at origin is another possible cause for difficulty in training deep neural networks using the logistic function; (2) we demonstrate that with proper scaling the logistic function achieves comparable results with the hyperbolic function tanh; (3) we propose a new activation function, the penalized tanh, which outperforms the ReLU function on the CIFAR10 dataset.
(1) rescaling the logistic sigmoid function is beneficial to training deep networks; (2) “penalized hyperbolic tangent” outperforms the ReLU and leakly ReLU.

the following questions.
the following three questions: (1) why tanh works well for deep architectures? (2) why the logistic sigmoid works well for deep convolutional networks?
the following questions: (1) Why the saturated functions are difficult to train in the deep architectures, and (2) What kind of activation functions are good for the deep architectures?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the saturation property is not necessarily the reason for the slow convergence.
the non-saturation property is more important than the zero-centered property for deep architectures, which is the reason why the ReLU family of activation functions have been so successful.
the activation function in deep neural network is a very important factor, and the saturation property is not the only reason causing difficulty to train deep networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the saturation property is not the main cause that makes training deep networks difficult.
we revise two saturated functions by rescaling and penalization and achieve comparable or better performance than the state-of-the art non-saturated ones.
the activation function is a very important factor in deep networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activation function should be carefully selected and designed to fit the problem.
, the slope of activation function near origin is more important than the saturation property in training deep neural networks.
the slope near the origin should be considered in the design of activation function.
